Irish Minister Predicts Future Border Poll on United Ireland

Irish Minister for Justice Helen McEntee stated that there will "be a border poll" on a united Ireland in the future. She indicated that the government needs to be prepared for such an event. McEntee's remarks followed comments by Andy Burnham, who suggested the issue was "off the table." The minister's statements have generated discussion and some backlash.
